<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>Item 3.02 Unregistered Sale of Equity Securities</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">As of October&#160;30, 2026, Monroe Capital
Asset-Backed Finance Company, LP &#8211; Series&#160;II (the &#8220;<b>Series&#160;II</b>&#8221;), a registered series of Monroe
Capital Asset-Backed Finance Company, LP (the &#8220;<b>Partnership</b>&#8221;), issued and sold 110 of its Standard Fee Class-S
Shares (&#8220;<b>Class&#160;S</b>&#8221;) and 110 of its Standard Fee Class-I Shares (&#8220;<b>Class&#160;I</b>&#8221;) of limited
partnership interest, $0.01 par value per share, for an aggregate offering price of approximately $5,592, reflecting a purchase
price of $25.42 per Class&#160;S share and $25.42 per Class&#160;I shares (with the final number of Class&#160;S and
Class&#160;I shares being determined on October 30, 2026).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

  <tr style="vertical-align: bottom; background-color: White">
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Standard Fee Class-I Shares</td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left">&#160;</td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: right">110</td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left">&#160;</td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left">$</td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: right">2,796</td><td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left">&#160;</td></tr>
  </table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The offer and sale of the Class&#160;S and Class&#160;I
shares was made pursuant to purchase agreements (the &#8220;<b>Purchase Agreements</b>&#8221;) entered into by the Partnership and each
of approximately 220 separate investors. In addition, pursuant to the Purchase Agreements, each investor acquired a promissory note co-issued
by Monroe Capital ABF Onshore Intermediate Holdings, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, Monroe Capital ABF Offshore Intermediate
Holdings, LP, a Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership, and Monroe Capital ABF REIT Intermediate Holdings, LLC, a Delaware limited
liability company, each a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Partnership (collectively, the &#8220;<b>Borrowers</b>&#8221;), each with a principal
amount of $1,000 and an aggregate principal amount of $220,000 (each a &#8220;<b>Note</b>&#8221; and collectively the &#8220;<b>Notes</b>&#8221;).
The aggregate net proceeds received by the Borrowers in exchange for the issuance of the Notes was $152,000. The Borrowers will pay interest
on the unpaid principal amount of the Notes at a rate of 12.00% per annum per Note payable semi-annually in arrears. The Notes have a
30-year term. Some or all of the Notes may be prepaid by the Borrowers at any time, in whole or in part, provided that (i)&#160;the Borrowers
will pay on the date of such prepayment all accrued and unpaid interest due on such prepaid principal amount to and including the date
of prepayment and (ii)&#160;if the first such prepayment occurs prior to the second anniversary of the issue date of the Notes, the Borrowers
will pay on the date of such prepayment a one-time premium equal to $100 per Note.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Partnership issued the Class&#160;S and Class&#160;I
shares of Series&#160;II and the Borrowers issued the Notes in private placement transactions pursuant to certain exemptions of the Securities
Act of 1933, as amended (the &#8220;<b>Securities Act</b>&#8221;), and the laws of the states and jurisdictions where any offering was
made, to investors who are &#8220;accredited investors&#8221; within the meaning of Rule&#160;501(a)&#160;of Regulation D promulgated
under the Securities Act.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Notes were offered through H&amp;L Equities,
LLC (&#8220;<b>H&amp;L</b>&#8221;), a registered broker dealer and an affiliate of REIT Funding, LLC (&#8220;<b>REIT Funding</b>&#8221;).
With respect to the Notes, Series&#160;II will pay fees to, and cover certain expenses of, REIT Funding. From the fees paid, REIT Funding
will be responsible for paying any brokerage or placement fees to H&amp;L. Series&#160;II will also pay fees to, and cover certain expenses
of, REIT Administration, LLC (&#8220;<b>REIT Administration</b>&#8221;), an affiliate of REIT Funding, for its administrative services
related to the Notes. Series&#160;II&#8217;s obligation to pay the fees to REIT Administration will end on the date when the Notes have
been paid in full and all administrative duties have been completed.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>The information in this Current Report on
Form&#160;8-K shall not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to purchase the Class&#160;S or Class&#160;I
shares, Notes or any other securities, and shall not constitute an offer, solicitation, or sale in any jurisdiction in which such an
offer, solicitation, or sale would be unlawful.</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The description above is only a summary of the
material terms of the Notes and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the copies of the Forms of Promissory Note, which are
filed as Exhibits 10.1 and 10.2 hereto and are incorporated by reference herein.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

its Third Amended and Restated Limited Partnership Agreement (the &#8220;<b>Third A&amp;R LPA</b>&#8221;), which amended and restated
the Second Amended and Restated Limited Partnership Agreement, dated as of September&#160;28, 2026. The amendment and restatement effects
certain changes to reflect additional provisions related to future potential borrowings.</p>
